Back Garden
T001 - Oak
Cut back from building to give 2 metre clearance.

T1 is a large mature oak tree located in the boundary of 89 Mawney road, please see attached map.
The works are part of a regular maintenance programme.
The works will improve the overall aesthetics of the tree.
The works are necessary to be carried out as the tree is touching the building with potential to cause damage.
